data.name: PackagedAppExtensionDescription
data.value: Registers a packaged MSIX test host and activates it by Application User Model ID (Windows build), delivering Microsoft Testing Platform arguments through argv for packagedClassicApp/win32App hosts (including classic AppContainer hosts) or launch activation for windowsApp/UWP hosts. When opted in through TESTINGPLATFORM_PACKAGEDAPP_LAUNCHER=always, it also deploys a non-packaged (loose-layout) Windows test host to an isolated directory and launches it from there. Enabled only for a packaged layout by default, so an unpackaged app is left on the default launch path. End-to-end AppContainer execution additionally requires controller-pipe authorization. See https://github.com/microsoft/testfx/issues/10486.
data.comment: Do not localize the environment variable name or its value {Locked="TESTINGPLATFORM_PACKAGEDAPP_LAUNCHER"}{Locked="always"}, nor the technology names {Locked="Microsoft Testing Platform"}{Locked="MSIX"}{Locked="Application User Model ID"}{Locked="Windows"}{Locked="packagedClassicApp"}{Locked="win32App"}{Locked="windowsApp"}{Locked="UWP"}{Locked="AppContainer"}.

data.name: AmbiguousAppxManifestApplication
data.value: The packaged app manifest declares multiple applications and none uniquely matches the executable '{0}'. Candidate Application User Model IDs: {1}.

data.name: AppxManifestApplicationExecutableMismatch
data.value: The packaged app manifest declares no application for the executable '{0}', so it describes a different application and activating it would target the wrong Application User Model ID. Declared application executables: {1}.
data.comment: Do not localize the technology name {Locked="Application User Model ID"}. {0} is an executable path. {1} is a comma-separated list of executable paths.

data.name: InvalidAppxManifestMissingIdentity
data.value: The packaged app manifest does not declare a valid <Identity Name="..." Publisher="..." /> element.

data.name: PackagedAppLaunchNotSupported
data.value: Cannot launch the packaged Windows app '{0}' (found '{1}'). Registering and activating a packaged (MSIX) app requires the Windows build of this extension, which ships for net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0 and later. Target 'net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0' (or a later net*-windows Target Framework Moniker at platform version 10.0.19041.0 or higher) so NuGet selects that asset. The current build only launches non-packaged (loose-layout) test hosts. See https://github.com/microsoft/testfx/issues/9933.

data.name: PackagedAppNoApplicationToActivate
data.value: Cannot activate the packaged Windows app '{0}' (found '{1}'): its manifest declares no <Application>, so there is no Application User Model ID to activate.

data.name: PackagedAppRegistrationFailed
data.value: Failed to register the packaged Windows app layout '{0}'. Registering an unsigned build-output layout requires Developer Mode (or sideloading) to be enabled. Error: {1}
